params.body: Dear Vendor-1, We are experiencing a temporary issue with processing your invoice correction-E5-221021. The payment of 30 has been delayed due to a budget limitation. We are working on resolving this issue and will contact you as soon as the payment can be processed. Thank you for your understanding.

Dear Vendor-1,

We are writing to inform you that we are unable to process the payment of 30 for the invoice correction-E5-221021 due to budget limitations within our current scope. We are currently exploring ways to resolve this issue and will contact you as soon as we have a solution. Thank you for your understanding.
